subject: Consolidate evening office-hours for NorthStar + Bluewave — single walk-through?
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Young <samantha@northstar.ai>, Diego Ruiz <diego@bluewave.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-15T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo time options — quick consolidation idea

Hi Samantha, Diego —

Quick thought: I see NorthStar and Bluewave both have evening demo interest for the week of Aug 22. Would you be open to consolidating into a single public "office-hours" style walk-through we run on Aug 22 so we can save calendar churn and open the slot to a few other engineers who want a hands-on Q&A?

Proposed format: 45–60 minutes, 30 minute demo + 15–30 minute live Q&A, high-level agenda attached. If that sounds good, tell me your absolute latest start time (PT) and any must-cover items so we can prioritize.

Tentative window: Aug 22, 17:30–18:30 PT (we can shift earlier by 30 min if needed).

If you prefer private one-off sessions instead, we can keep them separate — no pressure.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf]

From: Samantha Young <samantha@northstar.ai>

Date: 2028-08-15T16:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo time options — quick consolidation idea

Hi Ben —

Thanks — consolidation sounds great. NorthStar can do Aug 22 at 17:30 PT but 18:00 would be tough for a couple of our engineers (west coast). Main asks from our side: latency/throughput examples for 4k-context public models, and a brief section on Private (VPC) deployment concerns — specifically network egress and audit logs.

If you want a short poll, I can share available attendee names. Otherwise 17:30 PT is our preferred start.

Cheers,
Samantha Young
Director of ML Platforms
NorthStar AI

Ben —

Internal note before I reply-all: 17:00 PT is fine from an ops perspective, but that shortens our window for a Q&A if we want both infra and product questions. Suggest we offer two concrete choices to the customers: 17:00–17:45 PT (compact demo, heavier live Q&A follow-up via Slack) or 17:30–18:15 PT (standard demo + live Q&A). Also recommend we attach a one-page MAP with next steps and a 15-min follow-up slot optional for each account.

I'll take the lead on a concise agenda and MAP; Marissa can own the invite and calendar set up. If you're okay, I'll send the confirm to Samantha and Diego with both slot options and a link to a quick Doodle so they pick.

-Lauren
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-08-16T16:09:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Consolidated office-hours — Aug 22 (final)

Hi Samantha, Diego —

Thanks for the quick replies. Per internal ops recommendation, we can offer two fixed options and you can pick which fits your teams. To keep this tight, we're proposing the compact slot since it accommodates both teams' availability and preserves a shorter Q&A follow-up path if needed.

Finalized: Aug 22, 17:00–17:45 PT (45 minutes) — Redwood will record and share notes.
Agenda highlights (attached):
- 0–10m: Introductions + use-case alignment
- 10–30m: Live demo (inference runtime + batching/KV caching walkthrough)
- 30–45m: Focused Q&A (ops + product)

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx
Related link: https://cal.com/redwood/office-hours (calendar invite is live — accept to add to your calendar)

Action items:
- Samantha: confirm attendee list (names + roles) by Aug 18
- Diego: any specific infra slides to share by Aug 18 (optional)
- Marissa: send calendar invite + recording dial-in, include MAP

If anything changes I'll update the invite. Looking forward to it.

Best,
